name: vas
signature: void vas(int *a, const int *b, const int *ip, int n)

contract.execution: One execution of the original repetition-loop body, including local setup.
contract.aliasing: Distinct array arguments must have non-overlapping storage, matching the original globals. No restrict qualifier is added.
contract.arithmetic: Every evaluated signed arithmetic expression must be representable as int. Signed overflow is not defined as wraparound.
contract.memory: All array arguments are valid initialized buffers, also when n=0. No alignment beyond int alignment is required.
contract.notes: Duplicate destinations are allowed; preserve last-store semantics and untouched elements.

adaptations: remove harness and execute one computational repetition
explicit read-only index buffers; bounded but not assumed unique

testing.description: Data in [-3,3]; zero, one, minus-one, alternating, and seeded random trials.
